cards.text: By now Abraham, Isaac's father, is old and well along in years, and the LORD has blessed him in every way. So he calls in his chief servant, the man who manages everything he owns. I bet that servant walked in hoping for a raise.
Abraham wants him to swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, about his son Isaac. So much for the raise, friend, because this man is getting an OATH.

cards.question: Abraham is old, and this oath is about his son Isaac's future. What will the servant swear to do?

answers.text: Teach Isaac to run the household

cards.text: Abraham is living among the Canaanites. And he's very particular about where Isaac's wife comes from.

cards.question: True or false: Abraham wants his servant to find Isaac a wife from the daughters of the Canaanites living around him.
Instead, Abraham sends the servant to his own country and his own ___ to find Isaac a wife.

cards.text: The servant asks what happens if the woman won't come: "Shall I then take your son back to the land from which you came?" Friend, this man READS the fine print, and I respect it.
Abraham's answer: "Make sure that you do not take my son back there." Friend, that is NOT a maybe.

cards.question: Abraham reminds the servant that the LORD brought him from his father's house and his native land and promised him on oath. What did the LORD promise to give Abraham's offspring?

answers.text: The land he lives in now

cards.question: Abraham calls the LORD the God of heaven. Who does he say the LORD will send ahead of the servant so he can find Isaac a wife?
Abraham won't let Isaac go back. True or false: if the woman won't come, the servant is released from his oath.

cards.text: So the servant places his hand under his master Abraham's thigh and swears the oath.

The servant takes ten of his master's camels and all kinds of good things, and heads for the hometown of Nahor, Abraham's brother, in Aram-naharaim. TEN camels, friend, and I get nervous showing up with ONE cookie box.

cards.question: As evening comes, the servant makes his camels kneel down near the ___ outside the town.

cards.text: It's the time when the women come out to draw water. "O LORD, God of my master Abraham," the servant prays, "please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham."

cards.question: The servant asks the LORD for a sign. He'll ask a girl at the spring for a drink. What will the right girl do?

answers.text: Offer to water his camels too
Ask him to wait for her father
Ask him where his master lives

cards.text: Before the servant has even finished praying, out comes Rebekah with her jar on her shoulder: the daughter of Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Abraham's brother Nahor. Friend, the man didn't even get to amen, and I have waited LONGER for my oven to preheat.

cards.question: Rebekah is very beautiful. She fills her jar at the spring and comes back up. True or false: the servant waits for her to come over to him.

cards.text: He runs to her and asks for a little water, and she says, "Drink, my lord," and quickly gives him a drink from her jar. Half the sign, DONE.
After he drinks, Rebekah says, "I will also draw water for your camels…" That's the OTHER half of the sign, friend, and nobody even asked her!

cards.question: Rebekah has just one jar, and the servant has ten camels. True or false: she keeps running back to the well until she has watered all of them.
While Rebekah waters the camels, the servant watches her silently. What is he waiting to see?

answers.text: If the LORD made his trip a success
If she will ask him to pay her
If her family will come out to him

cards.question: After the camels finish drinking, the servant takes out gifts for Rebekah: a gold ring and two gold ___.

cards.text: Then he asks her, "Whose daughter are you?" She tells him she's the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milcah bore to Nahor.

cards.question: The servant also asked if there's room in Rebekah's father's house to spend the night. What does she tell him?

answers.text: There's a place and plenty of feed
He must ask her father first
Her father's house is too full

cards.text: Then the man bows down and worships the LORD. Prayer asked, prayer answered, and he does NOT skip the thank you.

cards.question: The servant blesses the LORD, the God of his master Abraham. What does he praise Him for?

answers.text: His kindness and faithfulness to Abraham
Sending rain for the thirsty camels

cards.text: Then he adds, "As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives." Hold that thought, friend, because this story still has a whole lot of oven time left.
